questions.stem: What is the SI unit of acceleration?
questions.explanation: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity with respect to time. Since velocity is measured in m/s and time in s, acceleration has units of m/s² (metres per second squared).

questions.stem: A car increases its velocity from 10 m/s to 30 m/s in 5 seconds. What is its acceleration?
questions.explanation: Acceleration = change in velocity / time = (30 - 10) / 5 = 20 / 5 = 4 m/s².
